pages.text: First confirm the explicit work order, owner, and loaded work area. Wait and Follow intentionally pause work. Read the status: full bag, missing tool or tier, missing material, exhaustion, storage unavailable, or unreachable route.

Empty cargo or provide a warehouse/Slime Chest. Put the requested tool, seed, sapling, empty bucket, or cobblestone in the correct bag. A bucket never substitutes for wall cobblestone. Open a route and clear the work position.

Mining, farming, logging, and trail placement honor mobGriefing and Forge protection. Work uses loaded terrain, Reach, and sight. Extra stats or supplies cannot bypass denied edits. A $(l:companions/herald)Signaling Slime$() can report lasting blockages.
